# Actors' Equity Association

> > The national labor union representing professional actors and stage managers in live theatrical productions across the United States.

Actors' Equity Association negotiates contracts, wages, and working conditions for theatre professionals, with major offices in New York City, Chicago, and Los Angeles. The union provides resources for collective bargaining, diversity and inclusion initiatives, and theatrical employment standards.
